\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fuzz}
\begin{document}
\begin{zed}
  maxPos == 2
\end{zed}
\begin{schema}{Probe}
  pos : \nat
\where
  pos \leq maxPos
\end{schema}
\begin{schema}{InitProbe}
  Probe'
\where
  pos' = 5
\end{schema}
\begin{schema}{Hold}
  \Delta Probe
\where
  pos' = pos
\end{schema}
\end{document}
